europe_now.title: Russian Strikes Impact Ukrainian Energy Infrastructure
europe_now.summary: Recent military strikes by Russia have left hundreds of thousands of residents without power in eastern Ukraine. Energy infrastructure remains a primary target, causing widespread disruption to daily life and essential services.

sources.headline: Russian strikes leave 600,000 in the dark in eastern Ukraine
Ukraine: Russian strikes leave hundreds of thousands without power

europe_now.title: Terror Investigation Launched Following Fatal Shootings in Poland
europe_now.summary: Polish prosecutors have initiated a terrorism investigation after a violent shooting incident resulted in multiple fatalities in Kraków. The community and national authorities are responding to the security shock caused by the attack.

sources.headline: Prosecutors launcher terror investigation as Poland reels from fatal shootings
Poland in shock after 6 killed in Krakow far-right shooting

top_stories.title: European Participation in Upcoming Peace Negotiations
top_stories.summary: European representatives are scheduled to participate in upcoming peace negotiations regarding the conflict in Ukraine. The discussions are being coordinated with international partners to address ongoing regional security concerns.

top_stories.title: Wirecard Fugitive Communications Disclosed
top_stories.summary: Messages from a prominent fugitive associated with the Wirecard scandal have revealed claims involving high-level political interference. Investigators are examining communications allegedly sent to a foreign intelligence contact.
